heading: The beauty about Mokka Pots
subheading: Feels like a small espresso machine, but it is not. It is a Mokka Pot.
paragraphs: With a bean grinder, focus on how many grams of coffee you put in and how much water, you can get this coffee routine that is very calming. Further more you can get very much out of this, the more you try and the more you experiment with it. The more you try, the more you learn about coffee and how to get the best out of it.
I started without a grinder, but now since I have one, I'll never be able to get back ((:
